name: e5_same_source_section_preference
translation_also_if: question contains a dotted chapter.verse token matching \b\d{1,2}\.\d{1,3}\b
precedence: If any purport cue matches, intent=purport even if translation cues also match (commentary request is more specific).
neutral: If neither purport nor translation cues match, keep raw E5 order.
rerank: Sources keep the order of their first E5 hit. Within a source, the requested section's chunks (still in E5 order) are placed before the other section's chunks. Neutral: no change.
safety: Section preference cannot promote a chunk whose source never appeared in E5 Top 50. Rank-40 unrelated translations cannot outrank E5 rank 1.
